source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: The PDF has a real text layer (mixed with the diagonal icseboard.org watermark); text taken from it and checked against the rendered page images. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2022 comes from the file name (…-200922-2022, i.e. 20-09-2022). Marks come from the section headings: Section A 1 mark each (10 MCQs), Section B 2 marks each (attempt any 5 of 6), Section C 3 marks each (attempt any 5 of 6), so 10 + 10 + 15 = 35; the item total is higher because of the optional questions. Section B numbers its sixth question "Q.V" a second time. The WhatsApp/Paytm advertisement footer (partly in Hindi) on page 4 is ignored. No school name printed.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
